acceptance_criteria: scale_build_metrics audit status is PASS with blocking_findings_count 0 on current committed evidence.
Canonical real rungs 30, 50, and 100 are present and trace to wrapper-produced JSON evidence.
Failed or can_run=false resource preflight for canonical rungs remains blocking.
Real evidence requires real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x, exact node count, cluster_state_observed ok, probe_result PASS, and data_path_result PASS.
30-node unavailable timing metrics remain explicit MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reasons, not invented values.
50/100 timing, setup, runtime, cleanup, and report consistency metrics are measured from JSON artifacts.
P14 direct dry-run planner/resource metadata is allowed only as non-real coverage; P14 real evidence or real 1000-node rungs remain blocking.
Rendered HTML/SVG/CSV/Markdown are not accepted as measured metric sources.
CI runs the scale_build_metrics audit and schema check before metric coverage generation.
risks: Focused pytest was reported by the user as passing in the main venv; this review did not rerun that suite because prior local python lacked pytest.
The schema intentionally uses the repository-supported subset, so some metric status/value/reason invariants are enforced by tests rather than conditional schema keywords.
Future changes to P14 artifact shapes should preserve the distinction between dry-run metadata and real scale evidence.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14 or any real 1000-node gate for L07 validation.
Do not count P14 dry-run planner/resource metadata as real Valkey coverage.
Do not count rendered report views as measured metric sources.
Do not fabricate missing timing, cleanup, or build metric values.
Do not weaken harness controls, gate locks, schemas, phase manifests, or CI ordering to pass the stage.
